div.head: IV Atr 2.5
div.ab: Homines de Rotomago, qui ueniebant cum uino uel craspisce, dabant rectitudinem sex sol. de magna naui et XX. frustum de ipso craspisce.
Homines de Rotomago qui veniebant cum vino vel craspisce dabant rectitudinem sex sol. de magna navi et viginti frustum de ipso craspisce.
Leute von Rouen, die mit Wein oder Wal [d. i. Fettfisch: Walfisch und Delphin] kamen, gaben als Gebühr 6 Schill. vom grossen Schiff und die zwanzigste Schnitte von jenem Wal.
Men from Rouen who came with wine or whale [i.e. ‘fat fish’: whale and porpoise] gave as due 6 shillings for a large ship and the twentieth slice of that whale.
Men of Rouen, who came with wine or blubber-fish paid a duty of 6 shillings for a large ship and 5% of the fish.
